name: tianming-novel-agent-durable-control-plane
title: Tianming Novel Agent Durable Control Plane
description: 将已确认的 Tianming 小说 Agent 设计转化为可分阶段实施的 Durable Web/Application Control Plane：持久化会话与 GoalProposal 生命周期、PostgreSQL 控制面、TaskAttempt/lease/fence/provider recovery、Review/Acceptance/Canon/Outbox，以及 REST/SSE/前端 projection 接线。父任务只拥有跨子任务的合同、依赖和最终集成验收，不直接替代子任务实现。
creator: lyston
notes: 规划任务。父任务不启动实现；先完成子任务规划和依赖收敛。不得修改 EcomGen、删除/迁移 old 或把 AgentCore 变成小说业务状态机。

meta.productBoundary: REST commands and projections own durable business truth; SSE is notification only; AgentCore events are observation only.
meta.migrationRule: Migrate old novel semantics and EcomGen engineering patterns selectively; reimplement Tianming contracts.
meta.integrationAcceptance: A user-scoped conversation proposal can be durably confirmed and started, dispatched through a fenced worker, reviewed and accepted into Canon transactionally, and observed through typed REST projection plus replayable SSE without client-side state ownership.
meta.implementationPolicy: Start only one child at a time; child dependencies are explicit in each child artifact. Parent remains planning until all children are implemented, checked, and integrated.
meta.outOfScope: Whole-book generation, unrestricted dynamic DAG, multi-agent orchestration, full RAG, legacy deletion, EcomGen integration, and browser E2E infrastructure unless a child explicitly proves an existing low-cost path.
